name: eject-disk-images
title: Eject Disk Images
description: Eject every mounted disk image, like DMG and ISO files, while leaving physical drives untouched.
author: dimik

commands.name: eject-all-disk-images
commands.title: Eject All Disk Images
commands.description: Eject all mounted disk images at once without touching physical drives.

commands.name: manage-disk-images
commands.title: Manage Disk Images
commands.description: Browse mounted disk images and eject them one at a time or all together.

preferences.name: forceEject
preferences.title: Force Eject
preferences.label: Force-eject images that are busy
preferences.description: If a normal eject fails (e.g. a file from the image is still open), retry with hdiutil -force. Unsaved data on the image may be lost.

preferences.name: skipBackups
preferences.title: Skip Backups
preferences.label: Never eject Time Machine / backup bundles
preferences.description: Leave .backupbundle and Time Machine sparsebundles mounted so network backups are not interrupted.

preferences.name: excludePatterns
preferences.title: Exclude Images
preferences.description: Comma-separated text fragments. Any image whose file path or volume name contains one of them is left mounted (e.g. Ableton, Kontakt Library, VeraCrypt).

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
